description: This file defines a SocialService class with static methods to interact with external apps and services, such as WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Maps, and phone/SMS functionalities. It facilitates opening these apps or services with specific parameters based on external links constants.

classes.name: SocialService
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to interact with social media and communication apps.

methods.name: openWhatsApp
methods.description: Opens WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message.

methods.name: callRestaurant
methods.description: Initiates a phone call to the restaurant's phone number.

methods.name: openInstagram
methods.description: Opens the restaurant's Instagram profile in an external application.

methods.name: openDirections
methods.description: Opens Google Maps to show directions based on the predefined query.

methods.name: shareLocation
methods.description: Shares the restaurant's location via SMS.
